what: Fixed audio timbres for the Identity Forest. Generated ONCE by a sound model, then treated as static assets — the mapping from record to sound (who, when, pitch, blend) is a pure deterministic function of the Seed data; these files are only the instrument.
regenerate: bun run infra/skills/sonic-signature/scripts/fal-audio.ts --prompt <prompt> --seconds <s> --seed <seed> --out assets/audio/<name>.wav  (note: model outputs are not bit-reproducible even with a fixed seed — regeneration changes the instrument, not the score)
processing: ffmpeg: one-shots trimmed to a single attack + fade; all stems loudness-normalised (textures -19 LUFS, bed -23 LUFS, one-shots -16/-17 LUFS); encoded AAC 96-112k to web/*.m4a

stems.name: bed-forest
stems.role: resting-state ambience, always on when sound is enabled
stems.prompt: very quiet forest ambience at dawn, soft air tone, sparse distant birdsong, gentle leaves, warm and calm, extremely minimal, seamless loop, no music, no drums, no vocals

stems.name: note-pluck
stems.role: one note per person; playbackRate-shifted from measured C3 root to each person's pentatonic note
stems.prompt: single soft harp pluck, one note only, middle C, warm, intimate, clean natural decay to silence, no drums, no vocals
